args.title: Use PUBLIC_URL env var instead of localhost for password reset links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently hardcodes `http://localhost:3000` as the `BASE_URL` when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to localhost, which is unreachable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to rely entirely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` for the base URL, ensuring the link uses the correct production domain or configured URL.
